Bandoneon MIDI Visualizer

Static client-side app for MIDI keyboard input and MIDI upload with separate 142/144 bandoneon layouts.

Mapping JSON: array of objects like {"id":3,"side":"left","label":"B3","push":{"note":60,"x":0.3,"y":0.7},"pull":{"note":62,"x":0.3,"y":0.7}}
MIDI status: No MIDI access yet
Incoming note: —
Velocity: —
Active mapping buttons: —

Colors are by octave. Click any visual button to simulate press. Upload a mapping.json to use an exact bandoneon layout, or edit mappings.js for separate 142 and 144 layouts.

To deploy: push this folder to a GitHub repo and enable GitHub Pages (branch: main or gh-pages), it'll serve as a static site.
